summary: Multi-service professional website with blog and comprehensive SEO optimization targeting national/international searches for legal consulting, business consulting, digital marketing, graphic design, video editing, and web development services
architectural_notes: SEO-first architecture with structured data (JSON-LD) for professional services
XML sitemap generation for search engine crawling
Semantic HTML with proper heading hierarchy for better rankings
Open Graph protocol implementation for social media sharing
Performance optimizations targeting Google Core Web Vitals

existing_features.title: Add comprehensive meta tags to index.html including title optimized for 'Legal Consultant | Business Consultant | Digital Marketing | Graphic Design | Video Editing | Web Development', meta description highlighting all six service areas, and relevant keywords for national/international searches

Implement JSON-LD structured data for Professional Service schema covering legal consulting, business consulting, digital marketing, graphic design, video editing, and web development services with proper schema.org markup

Add Blog Post schema (Article/BlogPosting) to all five existing blog article pages (digital marketing, graphic design, law/legal, video editing, web design/dev) with proper headline, author, datePublished, and image properties
Enhance Open Graph tags in index.html with og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type optimized for social media sharing of the multi-service professional portfolio
Generate an XML sitemap that includes all main pages (home, about, services, skills, portfolio, contact, blog landing) and all five blog article pages with proper priority and changefreq values
Add robots.txt file to frontend/public allowing all crawlers and referencing the sitemap location
Enhance semantic HTML structure across all pages ensuring proper heading hierarchy (h1, h2, h3), meaningful alt text for all images, and ARIA labels where appropriate for accessibility and SEO
Optimize page performance by implementing lazy loading for images, code splitting for routes, and ensuring Core Web Vitals metrics (LCP, FID, CLS) meet Google's recommended thresholds
Update SEO utility (lib/seo.ts) to support dynamic meta descriptions and keywords for each page, ensuring services pages and blog articles have unique, keyword-optimized metadata
Add canonical URL tags to all pages to prevent duplicate content issues and ensure proper indexing by search engines
